# pennylane_client

> Unofficial, zero-dependency Ruby client for the Pennylane Company API v2. Version 0.1.0, pre-1.0. Not affiliated with Pennylane.

Usage: `gem install pennylane_client`, `require "pennylane_client"`, then `PennylaneClient.new(token: ...)`. All 178 operations are reachable through `client.call(:operationId, ...)`, and each of the 177 live ones has a stable Ruby name, such as `client.customer_invoices.finalize(id)`. Lists return an `Enumerator::Lazy`. Stays inside Pennylane's rate limit of 25 requests per 5 s per token within one process (share a limiter to cover several) and never retries a write after a 5xx or a timeout unless asked (`retry: :always`). Ruby >= 3.3, MIT licensed.

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Components, the request path, connections, rate limiting, pagination, the public/private boundary, design rationale and where the design strains
- [Design diagram](docs/architecture/design-diagram.md): The whole gem on one page
- [Performance](docs/performance.md): Load, stress and soak results against FakePennylane, and how to reproduce them
- [Contract snapshot](docs/api/README.md): The dated, generated copy of the Pennylane API the gem is measured against, and how drift is detected
- [Checklist](docs/api/CHECKLIST.md): Every operation with its registered, named and live status (generated)
- [Domain language](CONTEXT.md): Operation, Registered and Named operation, Experimental, Resource group, Contract snapshot, Clean room, Drift
